The '''Thaereian military police''' was a [[Army/Legends|military]] [[Law enforcement agency/Legends|police]] force that served the [[Thaereian military]].<ref name="TINYF" /> Around [[20 BBY]],<ref name="20 BBY">The ''[[Living Force Campaign Guide]]'' states that the [[Living Force (roleplaying campaign)|''Living Force'']] campaign is set one [[Standard year/Legends|year]] after the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]], an event that is dated to [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]] by ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''. As the ''Living Force'' adventure ''[[Below the Belt: Philology|Philology]]'' [[Cularin's disappearance|moved]] the campaign forward ten years to the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], and the adventure ''[[Night Eyes: Night's Homecoming|Night's Homecoming]]'' established that by Year 4 of the campaign over a year had elapsed since the events of ''Philology'', ''[[Thaere Is Not Your Friend]]'' can therefore be dated to circa [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]].</ref> the [[Thaereian]] military police arrested<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|II|11|Haman, Gerta}}</ref> the activist [[Gerta Haman]] after she made claims on the news program ''[[Eye on Cularin]]'' about links between the [[Thaereian military]] and the [[InterGalactic Banking Clan/Legends|InterGalactic Banking Clan]].<ref name="TINYF" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Thaereian military police first appeared in ''[[Thaere Is Not Your Friend]]'', a short story by [[Morrie Mullins (real person)|Morrie Mullins]] and published on [[Wizards.com]] in [[November]] [[2003]], which depicted the arrest of Gerta Haman by [[Officer/Legends|officers]] of the Thaereian military. Haman's entry in the [[2008]] compendium ''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]'' later identified the officers that arrested her as members of the Thaereian military police.
